projects.description: We are seeking an elite AI Architect to construct an enterprise orchestration layer that connects Claude 3.5 Sonnet, GPT-4o, and Gemini 2.0 with streaming telemetry, tool fallback logic, and sub-100ms vector retrieval cache.

applications.freelancerHeadline: Senior Full Stack & AI Systems Architect
applications.proposal: I have designed similar multi-LLM orchestrators with dynamic streaming fallback. I will deliver a clean FastAPI service connected to LangGraph, paired with a real-time reactive Next.js dashboard.
applications.coverLetter:
Dear Aetheria Labs Team,

I reviewed your architecture requirements. In my recent Synthetix project, I handled 45 concurrent agent streams with zero latency degradation using connection pooling and async Redis caching.

I can start immediately and deliver the initial working prototype within 10 business days.

milestones.description: Design schema, setup FastAPI endpoints and model connector interfaces.

milestones.title: Phase 2: Streaming Telemetry & Vector Cache Integration
milestones.description: Sub-100ms cache with Redis and streaming response generator.

milestones.title: Phase 3: Next.js Frontend Dashboard & Production Deployment
milestones.description: Complete UI monitoring workspace, benchmark tests and container setup.

reviews.comment: Elena delivered extraordinary results. Her architectural understanding of agentic systems and speed of execution is top-tier. Exceeded all our benchmarks.

messages.content: Hi Elena, we reviewed your proposal for the LLM Orchestrator. Are you available for a quick technical alignment?
Absolutely! I reviewed the spec doc and have already prepared the baseline fallback flowchart.
The Redis streaming vector pipeline is ready for test payload verification.
